name: Medusa
description: PVR alternative to Sonarr for TV shows: searches indexers, grabs episodes automatically and post-processes them into your library.
compose:
services:
  medusa:
    image: lscr.io/linuxserver/medusa:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:8081"
    environment:
      PUID: "1000"
      PGID: "1000"
      TZ: "UTC"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/config
      - /tv:/tv
      - /downloads:/downloads
    restart: unless-stopped
